floor_history.headline: Recon s1: floor 28 -> 23 (lost WIP re-applied + two structural corrections); full diff map banked — one coupled arg-home/s-reg-rotation cluster remains, twin func_8008BF04 shares it

frontier.hypothesis: The 4-pseudo s-register rotation (dominant ~20 pts) flips via a C lever visible in the allocno priority order
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 global.c allocates callee-saves in allocno priority order (reg_n_refs/live-length); target's order is counter->s0, wait_val->s2, loop_flag->s3, arg1->s4 vs ours loop_flag->s0, counter->s2, arg1->s3, wait_val->s4
frontier.next_probe: Forensics: -da greg dump via instrumented cc1 (tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1, BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG) on the sandbox .i; read the four pseudos' priorities/conflicts; then sweep ref-count/live-range levers (declaration order, split reads, named intermediates) toward target's order

frontier.hypothesis: Entry trampoline (j main_work; move s2,zero) collapses only TOGETHER with the arg-home fix
frontier.mechanism: Target's beqz delay slot holds s0=0 because move s4,a1 already happened at prologue insn 3; ours occupies that slot with the arg-home. Standalone s0-placement probes measured 31 (s1) and 33 (2026-08-06)
frontier.next_probe: Re-sweep s0=0 placements ONLY after arg1 allocates to s4 and homes early; then check whether prologue_fix/maspsx reproduce target's sw-s4-first save order naturally
